requirement_context.formal_requirement: The system shall expose POST /properties/{property_id}/favorite to an authenticated user or admin, accepting a positive property_id; it shall validate REQ-6-001, REQ-6-002, and REQ-6-006, create the caller favorite relation, atomically perform the stated creation, be non-idempotent, return 201 with Location, and emit only 201, 401, 404, 409, 500, 503.

relevant_domain_invariants.requirement: Property, agent, saved-search, and favorite ids are immutable positive integers; non-positive ids are not found.

A property has title 5..160 trimmed characters, property_type APARTMENT, HOUSE, VILLA, OFFICE, LAND, city 2..80, area_sqm integer 10..10000, rooms integer 0..50, price_cents integer 1000..2000000000, and status ACTIVE or ARCHIVED.
A favorite is unique by caller account and property and may reference only an ACTIVE property; deleting a favorite never changes the property.

requirement_context.formal_requirement: The system shall expose POST /saved-searches to an authenticated user or admin, accepting JSON name and filters; it shall validate REQ-6-005 through REQ-6-007, create a caller-owned saved search, atomically perform the stated creation, be non-idempotent, return 201 with Location, and emit only 201, 400, 401, 409, 415, 422, 500, 503.

relevant_domain_invariants.requirement: A saved search belongs to one caller account, has name 2..80 unique per account, and stores only validated city, property_type, price, area, rooms, and agent filters.
Property search filters use AND semantics; city is case-insensitive exact after trimming, price_min <= price_max, area_min <= area_max, rooms_min <= rooms_max, and status defaults to ACTIVE.
